prompt: we're planning to deploy this api to prod next week. is it ready? give me the list of what needs fixing first
assertions: Gives an explicit overall verdict of not ready / not production-ready
Flags the missing authentication/authorization layer (no Spring Security) as a top-priority / blocker issue
Flags hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind=TRACE (or SQL parameter logging) as leaking personal/sensitive data into logs
Flags the default DB credential fallback (${DB_PASSWORD:admin} / admin) in application.properties
Flags that clients can set payment status (e.g. to COMPLETED) via a public endpoint as a business/security risk
Reports the outcome of actually running the test suite (./mvnw test) with pass/fail counts or a stated reason it could not run
Gives at least 5 findings with file:line locations
Contains no false positive claiming foreign-key columns are unindexed and does not recommend JOIN FETCH on PESSIMISTIC_WRITE lock queries
